summary: TRUCKSonROAD DB-Backup-System (mongodump+tar.gz local + Infomaniak Swiss Backup S3) fully verified end-to-end. 12/12 backend pytest tests pass against REAL Infomaniak S3 bucket emergent-apps-backup with prefix 'truck/'. Full lifecycle tested: create → local file in /app/backups → cloud upload to s3://emergent-apps-backup/truck/mongodump-*.tar.gz → list local → list cloud → delete cloud → delete local → cleanup verified. Auth guard (401 without cookie) confirmed. PUT /cloud/config partial-update preserves secret_key (masked, never leaked in GET response). Frontend /admin/backups page: all 8 form fields rendered, 'aktiv' badge visible, sidebar 'Backups' entry with Database icon between 'Rechtliches' and 'Export', cookie banner correctly hidden on /admin/*, run-now creates real local+cloud archive (verified via UI list refresh + screenshot), Verbindung-testen toast 'Gelöscht' confirmed via screenshot, retention 30→14 save+reload persisted (verified via final screenshot). Daily backup loop registered in backend startup log: 'DB-Backup: next run at 2026-05-13T03:00:00+02:00 (in 62578s)'. Test bucket cleanup: all truck/mongodump-* objects deleted from Infomaniak Cloud. retention_days restored to 30 in DB.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/backups.py: GET /admin/backups/cloud/config returns 'access_key' in cleartext. This is acceptable for an admin-only endpoint, but consider also masking access_key for defense-in-depth, consistent with how secret_key is handled.

services/cloud_backup.py: _build_client raises ValueError but test_connection catches it and returns ok:false — good. However upload_archive and list_cloud_backups also call _build_client and surface ValueError to callers; routes/backups.py wraps them in try/except returning HTTP 500 — verify the daily loop also handles ValueError (it does: except Exception in _db_backup_loop).

routes/backups.py L62: get_current_user(request) is called but result is not used (no role check). Any authenticated user can list/create/delete backups. Recommend adding role=='admin' check (similar pattern likely used elsewhere). Currently the only protection is requiring login.

services/db_backup.py: rotate_local_backups uses LOCAL_RETENTION=14 from module load; good. However if BACKUP_LOCAL_RETENTION env var is changed at runtime, hot reload may not pick it up consistently. Minor.

AdminBackups.js cfgDraft.access_key resets to value coming from API; if API ever masks access_key in future, saving without re-entering would overwrite secret with masked version. Pattern matches secret_key handling (empty=keep) — consider same guard.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all 13 verified flows: login, cookie-banner-hidden-on-admin, intro-card-with-03:00-Europe/Zurich, cloud-card-aktiv-badge, all 7 form-field testids, run-now creates local+cloud entries, retention save+reload persists to 14, sidebar Backups entry with Database icon, delete UI removes items)

seed_data_creation: None persistent. 1 leftover local tar.gz in /app/backups (allowed per request). All Infomaniak S3 'truck/mongodump-*' test objects deleted via DELETE endpoint. retention_days restored to 30.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backups module is fully wired and tested against REAL Infomaniak Swiss Backup S3 bucket emergent-apps-backup. Credentials are seeded in DB settings (type='cloud_backup'). Daily loop runs at 03:00 Europe/Zurich; verify via grep 'DB-Backup: next run' /var/log/supervisor/backend.err.log. Frontend testids: admin-backups-intro, admin-backups-cloud-card, admin-backups-endpoint/bucket/prefix/access-key/secret-key/retention/enabled-toggle, admin-backups-test-conn, admin-backups-save-cfg, admin-backups-run-now, admin-backups-refresh, admin-backup-local-{filename}, admin-backup-cloud-{filename}. Cookie banner is correctly hidden on /admin/* via usePathname check in CookieBanner.js L63. Sonner toasts auto-dismiss in ~4s; use shorter wait or capture toast container immediately after action if needed in future tests. retention_days save+reload may need >4s wait before re-read (browser-side state hydration).
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found. All 28 acceptance criteria (12 backend pytest + ~16 frontend verifications) pass.
